## Lecture outline

::: {.lec-outline}
::: {.lec-group}
### From regression to neural networks

- Regression and curve fitting as introductory AI concepts
- Constructing a custom regressor
- Transition from a custom regressor to neural network architecture
- Bio-inspired intelligence
:::

::: {.lec-group}
### Network components

- Neural network layers
- Activation functions
- Output node types
- Loss functions for regression and classification
:::

::: {.lec-group}
### Backpropagation

- Backpropagation
- Forward pass and loss computation
- Backward pass and numerical examples
:::

::: {.lec-group}
### Training practice

- Training, validation, and test datasets
- Batch size versus epoch
- Python implementation examples
:::

:::
